proposals.before: During the reign of Khan Hendejin of the Yaolian line, his elder half-brother Angu'zhi served as ürün chijin of the Yaonian tribe.
proposals.after: During the reign of Khan Hendejin of the Yaolian line, his elder half-brother Angu'zhi served as ürün chijin of the Diela tribe.
proposals.reason: Chinese 叠剌部 is the Diela tribe, not the Yaonian (遙輦) tribe; the idiomatic English mislabels Angu'zhi's office.

proposals.before: Yaonian replied, "Great undertakings require men like him;
proposals.after: Diela replied, "Great undertakings require men like him;
proposals.reason: Chinese 叠剌 is the personal name of Taizu's brother speaking here, not the tribal/polity name Yaonian.

proposals.before: Yaonian said: "One who plots a great undertaking must employ men such as this;
proposals.after: Diela said: "One who plots a great undertaking must employ men such as this;
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise renders 叠剌 as Yaonian; it is the brother's personal name Diela.

proposals.before: Xiadǐ said, "The Yaonian tribe is large and strong, which is why it so often rebels; divide it in two to weaken its power."
proposals.after: Xiadǐ said, "The Diela tribe is large and strong, which is why it so often rebels; divide it in two to weaken its power."
proposals.reason: Chinese 叠剌部 denotes the Diela tribe; Yaonian (遙輦) is a different group.

proposals.before: Xiadǐ, whose style name was Nieliegun, was the son of Dila, ürün chijin of the Yaonian tribe and a descendant of the dynastic founder Suzu.
proposals.after: Xiadǐ, whose style name was Nieliegun, was the son of the ürün chijin Dila, who was a grandson of Suzu.
proposals.reason: Chinese 肅祖孫夷離堇怗剌之子 identifies Dila as Suzu's grandson and Xiadǐ's father; it does not name a Yaonian-tribe office here.

proposals.before: His follower Shengsi alerted Shou'an and Wuzhi that troops had surrounded them outside; Chaguo then sent men to murder the empress before the coffin and hurried out to give battle in confusion.
proposals.after: His follower Shengsi reported that Shou'an and Wuzhi had surrounded them outside with troops; Chaguo then sent men to murder the empress before the coffin and hurried out to give battle in confusion.
proposals.reason: Context shows Shou'an and Wuzhi as the surrounding force; the idiomatic English reverses who was alerted versus who surrounded the rebels.

decisions.reason: s0020 has 叠剌部夷離堇, so Angu'zhi's office is ürün chijin of the Diela tribe; 遙輦 names only Khan Hendejin's line, and the proposed replacement corrects that mislabel without other change.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 異母兄罨古只為叠剌部夷離堇

decisions.reason: After Taizu addresses his brothers, 叠剌曰 marks the speaker as Diela; rendering him as Yaonian invents the wrong name, and the proposed idiomatic correctly restores Diela.
The literal field likewise mistook 叠剌 for Yaonian; s0040's 叠剌曰 is the personal name Diela, and the proposed literal replacement is accurate.
Xiadǐ's counsel names 叠剌部, the Diela tribe; calling it the Yaonian tribe contradicts the Chinese, and the proposed idiomatic restores the correct tribal name.
肅祖孫夷離堇怗剌之子 makes Dila both ürün chijin and Suzu's grandson, and Xiadǐ his son; the original invents a Yaonian-tribe office and misattaches 孫, while the proposed wording matches the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 肅祖孫夷離堇怗剌之子

decisions.reason: 其黨矧斯報壽安、屋質以兵圍於外 means Chaguo's partisan Shengsi reported that Shou'an and Wuzhi had surrounded them outside with troops; the original reverses alert recipient and surrounding force, and the proposal fixes that.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 其黨矧斯報壽安、屋質以兵圍於外

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0002 shows the personal name Yaonian for p018 came only from mistranslating 叠剌; s0040 supports Diela, already claimed in c0097.
Accepted r0005 shows 肅祖孫 modifies Dila, not Xiadǐ; the explicit grandson-of-Suzu claim for p001 exists only from that misattachment.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 肅祖孫夷離堇怗剌之子

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0005 restores 肅祖孫 as Dila's kinship to Suzu; c0322 must read grandson/descendant-of with generationDistance 2, not child-of.
